messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: Packages instalation
parts: Did you try to run the example in the tutorial? If you can do that, the installation should have been completed successfully. Otherwise, you may remove your previous versions of R and packages and redo the installation to avoid potential conflicts between different versions of R.

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: Packages instalation
parts:
Looks like the doParallel package was not successfully installed. You'll need to either install the package by yourself with the command in R
install.packages("doParallel")
or use the Skyline installer again (as you did before).
